delivery_checks: Receive a production-approved video; do not derive a new montage in Growth.
Recheck actual upload support, cover, captions, audio and exact matching full-video continuation.

Share mechanic: Growth's distribution brief to content-engine carries the package's share block and proposes, as a hook, one moment that lands with no context in the first seconds, so a person can send the clip cold. It stays a proposal in the brief until content-engine adopts it as a production standard through its own route.

Before Krish sees it: a complete share block (social/share.json), no generic share call to action in the copy, and a blind send test whose reader names the declared receiver and job (crew/send-test); a revise verdict on the artwork goes back to content-engine as creative feedback through the brief.
Bind publication approval to the exact account, caption, ordered asset hashes, metadata and proposed time.
After a save, wait and independently reopen; reconcile uncertain outcomes before retrying.
measurements: Primary measure (Krish, 28 October 2026): sends, meaning native shares, per reach and saves per reach against the format's own channel median; a house hypothesis until MYMU's own dated data confirms it (lesson share-rate-measure).
Dated exposed reach and meaningful engagement, preserving missing values.
Relevant follower/profile movement and source-attributed publication subscriptions where exposed.
24-hour, 72-hour and seven-day readback after actual publication; no financial ROI inference from draft counts.
